arm.name: S5 v1.0 · 2×ATR stop, 2R target
arm.entries: the same candidates as arm B (every v1.5.0 entry rule, including R01 SPX GREEN at entry), same fill

rules_text: Entry: every MME v1.5.0 entry rule unchanged (R00-R09, R15). The candidate list and the fill are those of arm B.
Initial stop: entry wall - 2 x ATR(14). ATR is Wilder's, on Phoenix daily bars up to the previous close.
Take-profit: fill + 2 x (fill - initial stop). A limit sell: filled at the target when a 5-minute price reaches it; at the opening price if the stock opens above it.
R10: the stop climbs only to walls above the entry wall that the previous close holds (close >= wall + 0.25 EM): stop = wall - 2 x ATR.
R11: if the nearest wall at/below the close and the nearest above are more than 2 EM apart, stop = previous session high - 2 x ATR.
The stop only rises (R14) and must stay below the previous close. No T1 trailing.
SPX AMBER or RED after entry: hold. Only the stop or the take-profit ends a trade (no R01 cuts).
No position cap: cash only (open positions and today's signals count against the account).
Risk tiers as in v1.5.0 (1% / 1.5% / 2% by points; 1% if EM is more than 4% of the price).
Account size: starts at $2,000 / $10,000; moves in $1,000 steps of realised S5 P&L, recalculated only when S5 has no open position.
Costs: as in the MME test (IBKR $1 per round trip, flat; 0.05% slippage on market fills, 0.1% on gaps); the take-profit limit has no slippage.
